projectsIntro: Independent full-stack projects demonstrating web applications, backend APIs, data persistence and distributed-system reliability.

projects.title: Real-Time Logistics & Fleet Operations Platform
projects.technologies: React · TypeScript · Go · REST/WebSockets · Redpanda · PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB · Redis
projects.description: Built an end-to-end dispatcher platform with live fleet maps, delivery planning, assignment and recovery workflows. Connected React interfaces to Go REST and WebSocket services, streaming GPS updates through Redpanda and persisting history in TimescaleDB. Implemented alerts, transactional reassignment, durable state, restart recovery and operational metrics.

projects.title: Field Service & Asset Maintenance Management Platform
projects.technologies: Angular · ASP.NET Core · C# · .NET MAUI · PostgreSQL · SQLite · JWT · Docker
projects.description: Developed a field-service platform spanning an Angular supervisor dashboard, ASP.NET Core APIs and a .NET MAUI technician application. Implemented asset and work-order workflows, role-based access, offline SQLite outbox synchronisation, evidence capture, conflict handling and audit history. Validated API, database and offline replay behaviour with automated tests.

projects.title: Telecommunications Billing & Subscription Management
projects.technologies: Angular · Java · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL · Kafka · Redis · Flyway · Docker
projects.description: Engineered customer and administrator portals for subscription management, usage metering, billing and invoicing. Integrated Spring Boot APIs with PostgreSQL, Kafka and Redis; implemented transactional billing, idempotent event processing, reconciliation, access controls and PDF invoices. Verified large-event ingestion and replay against a local containerised stack.

projects.title: Distributed Systems Reliability & Chaos Engineering
projects.technologies: React · TypeScript · Go · PostgreSQL · RabbitMQ · Redis · Docker · Prometheus
projects.description: Built an e-commerce workload and reliability dashboard covering order lifecycle, durable sagas, idempotent transactions and outbox messaging. Integrated REST/SSE services with real telemetry and controlled fault experiments, then validated recovery, transactional consistency, bounded retries and isolated PostgreSQL backup restoration.
